source_anchor: Srivastava et al. 2014 "Dropout" §4; PyTorch torch.nn.functional.dropout reference
prompt_text:
Generate a deterministic dropout mask using LCG seed=12345 (multiplier=1103515245, increment=12345, modulus=2^31), p=0.3 dropout rate, n=20 elements. Mask convention: r

=p means kept (1). Print the integer sum of the mask.

exec_cell.code: let s=12345; const rand=()=>{s=(1103515245*s+12345)%2147483648;return s/2147483648;}; const p=0.3; const n=20; let sum=0; for(let i=0;i<n;i++){sum+=(rand()<p?0:1);} console.log(sum);
